spans.s: शल् (I) vt. 1Ā (pres. शलते) To shake, to agitate.
शल् (II) vt. 1P (pres. शलति) 1. To go, to move; 2. to run.
शल् (III) vt. 10Ā (pres. शालयते) To praise.
शाल् vt. 1Ā (pres. शालते) 1. To tell, to communicate; 2. to praise, to flatter; 3. to shine, to be endowed with, Mall. on Kir.v.44.
सल् vt. 1P (pres. सलति) To go, to move.
शल (I) m. 1. A dart; 2. an epithet of Brahman (m.); 3. a camel.
शल (II) n. The quill of a porcupine.
शल्ल (I) m. A frog.
शल्ल (II) n. Bark, rind.
शाल m. 1. Name of a tree, R.i.38, M.viii.246; 2. a tree in general, R.i.13; 3. a fence, an enclosure; 4. a name of king Śālivāhana.
शाला f. 1. The main branch of a tree; 2. a house, R.xvi.41; 3. a room, an apartment, a hall.
सल n. Water.
साल m. 1. Name of a tree or its resin; 2. a tree in general, e.g. रसालसालः समदृश्यतामुना; 3. a fence or wall surrounding a building, a rampart; 4. a wall in general; 5. a kind of fish. Cf. शाल.
साला f. 1. A house; 2. a rampart, a wall. Cf. शाला.
शलक m. A spider.

शलाका f. 1. An arrow; 2. a javelin; 3. a small stick, a peg, a pin, अज्ञानांधस्य लोकस्य ज्ञानांजनशलाकया । चक्षुरुन्मीलितं येन तस्मै पाणिनये नमः Śikshā.58; 4. a kind of pointed surgical instrument; 5. a bone, Yaj.iii.85; 6. a tooth-brush; 7. a painter’s brush; 8. a porcupine; 9. the sārika bird; 10. an oblong piece of ivory (used in gambling); 11. a shoot, a sprout, K.S.i.24.
शल्लक (I) m. Name of a tree.
शल्लक (II) n. Bark, rind.
शलंग m. A king, a sovereign.
शलभ m. A locust, a grasshopper, शलभसमूह इवाश्रमद्रुमेषु Sak.i., K.S.iv.40, Sis.ii.117.
शलल n. The quill of a porcupine.
शलली f. 1. A small porcupine; 2. the quill of a porcupine.
शलाकधूर्त m. a sharper.
शलाका-परि ind. an unlucky throw of a piece at the game of śalāka.
शलाटु (I) a. Unripe.
शलाटु (II) m. A kind of root.
शलाभोलि m. A camel.
शल्क n. 1. The scale of a fish, Yaj.i.178; 2. a piece, a portion; 3. bark, rind.
शल्क n. 1. The scale of a fish, Yaj.i.178; 2. a piece, a portion; 3. bark, rind.
शल्कलिन् m. A fish.
शल्कलिन् m. A fish.
शल्भ् vt. 1Ā (pres. शल्भते) To praise.
शल्मलि m. The silk-cotton tree.
शल्मली f. The silk-cotton tree.
शाल्मलि m.f. 1. The silk-cotton tree, Bh.V.i.115, Rt.i.26, M.viii.246; 2. one of the seven divisions of earth; 3. a particular hell.
शाल्मली f. 1. The silk-cotton tree; 2. a particular hell.
शल्य (I) m.n. 1. A javelin, a spear; 2. an arrow, a shaft; 3. a splinter, a thorn; 4. a pin, a peg.
शल्य (II) m. 1. A hedgehog; 2. a fence, a boundary; 3. extraction of splinters (in surgery); 4. name of a king of Madra, a maternal uncle of Nakula and Sahadeva.
शल्य (III) n. 1. Any extraneous substance lodged in the body, a dart (lit.), शल्यप्रोतं प्रेक्ष्य सकुंभं मुनिपुत्रम् R.ix.75; 2. any tormenting and heart-rending sorrow (fig.); 3. a bone; 5. sin.
शल्य-अरि m. an epithet of Yudhiṣṭhira.
शल्य-उद्धरण n. extraction of thorns.
शल्य-उद्धार m. extraction of thorns.
शल्य-कंठ m. a porcupine.
शल्यक m. 1. A dart, a javelin; 2. a thorn; 3. a porcupine.
शल्लकी f. 1. A porcupine; 2. name of a tree.
सल्लकी f. A kind of tree, शिशिरकटुकषायः स्त्यायते सल्लकीनाम् Ut.ii.
शल्लकी-द्रव m. incense.
शल्व m. Name of a country. (See शाल्व.)
शाल्व m. 1. Name of a country; 2. a king of that country.
साल्व (I) m. 1. Name of a demon-king slain by Viṣṇu; 2. name of a country.
साल्व (II) m. pl. The inhabitants of the Sālva country.
शाल-ग्राम m. a particular sacred stone typical of Viṣṇu.
साल-ग्राम f. a kind of stone.
शाल-ग्राम˚गिरि m. name of a mountain.
शाल-ग्राम˚शिला f. the Sālagrāma stone.
शाल-ज, -निर्यास m. exudation of the Sāla tree, R.i.38.
शाल-ज, -निर्यास m. exudation of the Sāla tree, R.i.38.
साल-निर्यास m. the exudation or gum of the sāla tree.
शाल-भंजिका f. 1. a doll, a puppet; 2. a courtezan, a harlot.
साल-भंजिका f. 1. a doll, a puppet; 2. a harlot.
शाल-भंजी f. a doll, a puppet.
शाल-वेष्ट m. the resin of the Sāla tree. Cf. साल.
शालव m. The Lodhra tree.
शाला-अजिर m.n. an earthen cup.
शाला-मृग m. a jackal.
शाला-वृक m. 1. a dog, Bh.V.i.72; 2. a cat; 3. a wolf; 4. a deer; 5. a jackal; 6. a monkey.
साला-वृक m. 1. a dog; 2. a jackal; 3. a hyena; 4. a wolf; 5. a wolf-like or cruel man. (Cf. शालावृक.)
शालांक m. An epithet of Pāṇini.
शालाकिन् m. 1. A spearman; 2. a barber; 3. a surgeon.
शालार n. 1. A bird-cage; 2. a ladder.
सालार n. A pin or peg projecting from a wall.
शाली m. 1. Rice, यवाः प्रकीर्णा न भवंति शालयः Mrich.iv., R.xv.78, M.ix.39, Bhartr.i.66; 2. the civet-cat.
शाली-ओदन m.n. boiled rice.
शाली-गोपी f. woman appointed to protect a rice-field, R.iv.20.
शाली-चूर्ण m.n. rice-flour.
शाली-पिष्ट n. crystal.
शाली-भवन n. a rice-field.
शाली-वाहन m. name of a celebrated sovereign of India; (the existence of such a sovereign is doubted by some scholars).
शाली-होत्र m. name of a writer on veterinary science.
शाली-होत्रिन् m. a horse.
शालिक m. 1. A weaver; 2. a toll, a tax.
शालिन् a. (f. नी) (generally at the end of a compound) Endowed with, possessed of, shining with, Bh.V.ii.3, Bt.iv.2.
शालिन् a. (f. नी) (generally at the end of a compound) Endowed with, possessed of, shining with, Bh.V.ii.3, Bt.iv.2.
शालिनी f. 1. A mistress of the house; 2. name of a metre. (See App. I.)
शालीन (I) a. (f. ना) 1. Bashful, retiring, ashamed, R.vi.81, xviii.17; 2. like, resembling.
शालीन (II) m. A householder.(शालिनीकरण n. ‘humiliating, humbling.’)
शालीन (I) a. (f. ना) 1. Bashful, retiring, ashamed, R.vi.81, xviii.17; 2. like, resembling.
शालु (I) m. 1. A frog; 2. a kind of perfume.
शालु (II) n. The water-lily.
शालु(लू)क n. 1. The root of the water-lily; 2. nutmeg.
शालु(लू)क n. 1. The root of the water-lily; 2. nutmeg.
शालु(लू)र m. A frog.
शालु(लू)र m. A frog.
सालूर m. A frog. Cf. शालूर.
शालेय m. A field of rice.
सालेय n. A sort of fennel. Cf. शालेय.
शालोत्तरीय m. An epithet of Pāṇini; (he is supposed to be a native of Śālottara). The word is sometimes spelt शालातुरीय.
शाल्मल m. 1. The silk-cotton tree; 2. one of the seven divisions of earth.
शाल्मलि-स्थ m. an epithet of Garuḍa.
शाल्मली-वेष्ट m. the gum of the silk-cotton tree.
सलिल n. Water, धूमज्योतिःसलिलमरुतां सन्निपातः क्व मेघः Megh.i.5.
सलिल-आशय m. a tank, a reservoir.
सलिल-इंधन m. the submarine fire.
सलिल-उपप्लव m. inundation, flood of water.
सलिल-क्रिया f. the funeral rite of washing a corpse.
सलिल-निधि m. the ocean.
सलोकता f. Residence in the same heaven with a particular deity (one of the four stages of Mukti).
साल-शृंग n. a wall-pinnacle.
सालन m. The resin of the sāla tree.
साला-कारी f. (according to some) 1. a house-worker; 2. a female captive, (especially one captured in battle).
सालोक्य n. 1. The being in the same sphere or world with another; 2. residence in the same heaven with any particular deity.
साल्व-हन् m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
साल्विक m. The sārika bird.
